map.8000 kbps、音频 384 kbps。视频体积 = 8000 × 10 ×: 8000 kbps, audio 384 kbps. Video size = 8000 × 10 × 60 ÷ 8 ÷ 1024 ≈ 585.9 MB; audio size = 384 × 10 × 60 ÷ 8 ÷ 1024 ≈ 28.1 MB; total ≈ 614 MB (about 0.60 GB). If H.265 is used instead (bitrate × 0.6): video size ≈ 351.6 MB, total ≈ 380 MB, saving about 38%. The tool generates the recommended bitrate, estimated size and FFmpeg command from the platform preset table plus the codec factors (H.265 × 0.6 / VP9 × 0.7 / AV1 × 0.5).
map.各平台推荐码率为什么差这么多？: Why do recommended bitrates differ so much across platforms?
map.由平台分发能力与播放端决定：YouTube 带宽充裕、推高码率保画质；微信/抖音: It is determined by the platform's distribution capability and the playback side: YouTube has ample bandwidth and pushes the bitrate up to preserve quality; WeChat and Douyin are mainly mobile and lower the bitrate to save data; archival backup pursuing lossless gets the highest. This tool has six built-in presets - YouTube / Bilibili / Douyin / WeChat / web / archive - and switching gives the matching parameters.
map.H.264、H.265、VP9、AV1 怎么选？: How do I choose between H.264, H.265, VP9 and AV1?
map.H.264 兼容性第一、体积最大；H.265/HEVC 省 30–50% 但苹果: H.264 has the best compatibility and the largest size; H.265/HEVC saves 30–50% but only gets hardware decoding on Apple and newer devices; VP9 is the first choice for the YouTube / Chrome family; AV1 saves the most data but encodes extremely slowly and has few supported devices. For general publishing choose H.264, for 4K or data saving choose H.265, and for web streaming choose VP9 / AV1.
